title: Ireland's most caps since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most caps for the Republic of Ireland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only caps from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Richard Dunne: Richard Dunne is 11th with 80, just outside.
notes.Steve Staunton: Steve Staunton won 102 caps, only 20 of them from 2000.
notes.Niall Quinn: Niall Quinn won 91 caps, only 17 from 2000.
notes.Robbie Keane: Robbie Keane won 146 caps; 13 came in 1998 and 1999.
notes.Shay Given: Shay Given won 134 caps; 23 came before 2000.
notes.Kevin Kilbane: Kevin Kilbane won 110 caps; 10 came before 2000.
notes.Damien Duff: Damien Duff won 100 caps; 13 came before 2000.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. The four who began before 2000 match the by-year tables in their Wikipedia articles (Keane 133, Given 111, Kilbane 100, Duff 87). The rest began after 2000 and agree with RSSSF and Wikipedia's list at the cut-off (Coleman 81, Dunne 80, Hendrick 79), except McGeady, 93 there and 92 on Transfermarkt (93 used; 6th either way).
